# `adt discovery`

Discover available ADT services

```bash
adt discovery [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                                  | Default |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Save discovery data to file (JSON or XML based on extension) |         |
| `-f, --filter <text>` | Filter workspaces by title                                   |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
